05Questions

Asked,
answered.

Everything founders usually ask before we start. Anything else — ask us on WhatsApp.

How long to rank in Maps?+

Most clients see Map Pack results in 30-60 days with proper GBP optimization and review generation.

Do you manage Google reviews?+

Yes. We set up automated review requests and help you respond professionally to all reviews.

What is a citation?+

A citation is a mention of your business name, address, and phone on other websites. It helps Google trust your location data.

Do I need a physical location?+

For Google Maps, yes. Service-area businesses can still rank but need a verified GBP.

How many reviews do I need?+

Quality matters more than quantity. We aim for 5+ reviews/month with 4.5+ star average.
